_comment: Congestion-hypothesis confirmation: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at --bw 100 (vs baseline 10 Mbps). Hypothesis: PrefixSync flood saturates 10 Mbps links, dropping DV heartbeats and causing FIB resets that leave the FIB short. At 100 Mbps, link utilization stays below 100% and FIB delta should be exactly 2000. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/rocketfuel_1755_onephase_bw100_3stage
name: rocketfuel_1755_onephase_bw100_3stage
description: Hypothesis confirmation: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at 100 Mbps. FIB should scale 1:1 with prefix count if congestion is the root cause.

jobs.name: stage1: DV convergence snapshot (onephase, 0 prefixes, bw=100)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p0 (import DV snap, bw=100)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p2000 (import DV snap, bw=100)
